title: Consequential actions always capped at L1
current: L0–L2 by default; L3/L4 only under an Active, eligible bounded mandate approved by two authorized people, scoped (counterparty, action type, per-action and aggregate value cap, time window, jurisdiction, data class), instantly revocable, with kill switch, PDP dispatch recheck, audit and reconciliation, in a jurisdiction whose rule pack permits it. No API scope for consequential actions (DEC-883).

title: Safety envelope "AI never signs, pays, submits bids, sets prices"
current: AI still never signs contracts and never sets prices autonomously; payments (DEC-780) and bid submission (DEC-781) may be executed by an agent only under a bounded mandate, through a licensed PSP or the approved portal, with exact package/amount hash, caps, kill switch and reconciliation.

title: "Service key held server-side" for the Django API
current: Django API and workers connect as least-privilege NOBYPASSRLS roles (`app_rw`, `app_worker`) setting `app.tenant_id` and `app.company_ids` per transaction; Data API (PostgREST) disabled for application schemas; `service_role` only in the CI migration pipeline under two-person, time-boxed break-glass with audit.

title: Database role names `ge_app` / `ge_worker` / `ge_owner` / `app_user`
current: Canonical roles: `app_owner`, `app_migrator`, `app_rw`, `app_worker`, `app_readonly`, `app_retention`, `app_platform_sec`, `app_bench`, `app_registry` (all NOBYPASSRLS). `ge_app` → `app_rw`, `ge_worker` → `app_worker`, `ge_owner` → `app_owner`, V12 `app_user` → `app_rw` (rename migration DDL-V12-R-16).

title: AWS-only topology (RDS, CloudFront, RDS cross-Region backups)
current: Vercel (web, edge firewall, region-pinned functions) + Supabase PostgreSQL (RLS, pgvector, PITR) + AWS (API, workers, Valkey, S3, SES, Secrets Manager/KMS) in Mumbai, with an EU stack for EU-resident tenants; deployment view Part 11.5b §11.5.5.8–11.5.5.9.

title: PostgreSQL 17 on Amazon RDS
current: Supabase-managed PostgreSQL (major version as provided by Supabase at provisioning; V12 DDL tested on 16.15 — verify at implementation, as of 28 Nov 2026); extensions pgvector and pg_cron subject to Supabase availability.

title: V12 screen IDs used bare where they collide with blueprint IDs
current: Blueprint screen IDs are primary. A V12 screen ID that collides (A114–A131, W35–W41) is always written `V12-<ID>` and mapped by the binding crosswalk (Part 11.7a §11.7.4.2–11.7.4.3; e.g. V12 A122 → A203). Investment screens are A205–A232 / W55–W76 (DEC-801) and A233–A259 / W77–W99 (Group O); Group P uses A260–A269 (DEC-962).

title: Screen range A205–A259 / W55–W99 "reserved and unused"
current: A205–A232/W55–W76 are used by Group N (DEC-801), A233–A259/W77–W99 by Group O; A260–A269 by Group P (DEC-962). Next free Admin ID: A270; next free Website ID: W100.

title: RTO 4 h at pilot / staged RTO
current: RPO ≤ 15 min in every residency region (continuous WAL, daily base backup, 35-day PITR; DEC-787). Growth-critical RTO ≤ 120 min is a release-blocking gate from Release 1 (OKPI-32 = V12 KPI-32; DEC-771). Core critical-tier RTO ≤ 4 h stays as the outer bound only for non-growth platform components (CDEC-V9-01). Regenerable stores RTO 24 h / RPO 8 h.

title: Single-region pilot / region count
current: Two residency stacks are built: India (Mumbai) and EU (e.g. Frankfurt), never writing one zone's personal data to the other (CJ-TC-09 blocking both ways; DEC-772). Further regions (UK, Middle East, APAC, then US) open only when each jurisdiction rule pack is counsel-approved (DEC-776). Residency is chosen at tenant onboarding.

title: SM-SVC-26 voice assigned to EP-08
current: SM-SVC-26 (AI voice) belongs to epic EP-22 (Part 11.2a registry; Part 11.18). Pattern references to EP-08 are read as EP-22.

title: Voice domain named `eng_call`
current: The V12 canonical domain is `voice_session` (with `voice_turn`, recording and consent artefacts per Part 11.18); `eng_call` is withdrawn.

title: Mandates and securities-governed investment actions
current: DEC-779 mandates apply only "where lawful". Securities-governed INV actions (offer issue, offering-tagged dispatch, closing, allotment reference, filing status, cap-table revision, vote certification, KYC decision, external submission) stay L1 with hash-bound, per-action approval (two-person for closing and cap table) and are never mandate-authorised (DEC-822, CP-O-04). A DEC-779 mandate may automate only non-offering investor-relations messages (mandate type `inv_ir_message`). The Part 11.17 mandate engine must reject these action types at issue and at dispatch.

title: Customer decision IDs written DEC-Vn-## / DEC-### for V12 decisions
current: Customer decisions are written CDEC-### and CDEC-Vn-## (DEC-700); bare DEC-### always means a blueprint decision.

title: V12 KPI-## used without the OKPI alias
current: V12 KPI-01…35 = OKPI-01…35 (DEC-681). Blueprint KPI-01…35 are the Part 1 business KPIs. Always write OKPI-## for V12 release KPIs.

title: V12 REC-01…30 collide with blueprint reconciliation jobs REC-01…09
current: Blueprint REC-01…09 are reconciliation jobs (Part 3.2). V12 REC-01…30 are reconciliation actions; write them `V12-REC-##`.

title: Messaging window 09:00–19:00 Mon–Sat
current: Promotional messages 09:00–21:00 in the recipient's local time (DEC-777); a stricter rule pack window wins; quiet hours, consent and suppression unchanged; transactional messages follow their own rules.

title: Business-hours support
current: 24×7 human on-call for SEV1/SEV2 and 24×7 security monitoring from Release 2 GA (contracted NOC/SOC first line, internal rota second line).

title: Investor / fundraising exclusion
current: Investor/fundraising mode and the Investment Automation product (INV-SVC-01…24, 96 workflows) are in scope with securities rule packs, eligibility verification, no public offer where prohibited, counsel sign-off per jurisdiction and no investment advice by AI.

title: Voice / recording / SMS prohibited
current: AI voice calling and recordings adopted (DEC-782) with AI self-identification, consent and DND scrubbing, calling windows, notice/consent for recording (all-party where required), retention limits, redaction and human hand-off. SMS via a DLT-registered aggregator in Release 1 (DEC-785, DEC-884).

title: Automatic bid submission prohibited
current: Automatic bid submission allowed only under a per-tender bounded mandate: a human approves package hash, price, terms and portal/authority; the agent submits exactly that package and records the receipt. Unmandated submission stays human.

title: Tier 2 free providers described as an active fallback chain
current: Only models approved in the provider-neutral registry (DPA with no-training clause, region, data class, evaluation suites, cost) may run; Claude Sonnet is the approved primary; free tiers never receive personal or restricted data.

title: Fixed release dates as commitments
current: Dates are indicative; Release 1 and Release 2 are re-planned from approved effort and measured throughput; scope is not cut to meet a date (master plan Part 11.20).

title: Judge agreement ≥ 85% vs κ ≥ 0.8
current: AI-judge calibration uses Cohen's κ ≥ 0.8 against human labels (AIX-07).

title: Admin not targeted below 768 px
current: One responsive Admin build with a compact layout for all registered screens (MOB-01/06).

title: Outbound webhooks not offered
current: Signed outbound webhooks are part of the Release 1 developer platform (DEC-785; DEC-645).

title: Benchmarks disabled / ε = 1
current: Cross-tenant benchmarks in Release 2: opt-in contract clause, cohorts ≥ 10 tenants (k ≥ 10), dominance ≤ 30%, Laplace ε = 0.5 per metric per cell per month (yearly cap 6), zone-local computation.

title: Voice transport "R3+ → W6"
current: Voice CPaaS transport is a Release 1 connector (DEC-884); AI voice features per Part 11.18 release plan.

title: Missing tenant context returns zero rows
current: Missing `app.tenant_id` must raise an error (fail closed), not return zero rows (V12 DB-T2).

title: BYOK limited to AWS KMS
current: Customer-managed keys across clouds (DEC-776).

title: Money stored as numeric(18,2)
current: Money in integer minor units (`*_minor bigint`) with currency; arithmetic CHECKs in the database; expand/contract migration MG-02…04.

title: Run-state vocabularies differ
current: One run-state vocabulary: Pending, Running, Waiting, Held, Paused, Reconciling, Succeeded, Failed, Cancelled (+ Blocked for preflight holds), mapped to the Part 3.2 API states (DEC-561).

current: Blueprint workflows are WF-01…WF-60 with WF-24 and WF-40 unused; V12 workflows are SM-SVC-##-WF# (156) and INV workflows.
